title: Secret Leakage via case class toString()
platform_conditions: Scala 2.13 / Scala 3 standard library on the JVM (scala.util.Random delegates to java.util.Random; case class toString is compiler-generated)
security_mechanism: scala.util.Random wraps java.util.Random's 48-bit LCG: its state is fully determined by a small number of observed outputs, so tokens or reset codes drawn from it are reconstructible from a few samples. Secret-bearing values leak through compiler-generated code the author did not write: case class toString includes every field, so logging or exception-wrapping a credentials case class prints passwords into logs and error pages. Digest comparisons written with == short-circuit on the first differing byte, giving a timing oracle byte-by-byte over MessageDigest output; MessageDigest.isEqual is the constant-time counterpart on the JVM.

source_sink_clues.source: The secret values themselves: generated tokens, credential case class instances, and digest/MAC byte arrays compared in decision code.
source_sink_clues.sink: scala.util.Random for security values; case class toString / productElement access exposing secret fields into logs and responses; == / != over digest arrays

tracking_guards: Check tokens come from java.security.SecureRandom or a CSPRNG wrapper; check credential types override toString (or keep secrets out of case classes) and never reach logger calls whole; check digest comparisons use MessageDigest.isEqual.
not_candidate_when: Random drives only non-security sampling, the printed type carries no secret fields and never reaches logs, or the comparison is over non-sensitive nonces with no attacker oracle.
synthetic_vulnerable_example: case class UserCredentials(username: String, pass: String)
synthetic_safe_example: case class UserCredentials(...) { override def toString = ... }
public_references: CWE-338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/338.html
CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/532.html
